manual.basic_tools.line2: {0}Engineer's Hammers are one of the most important tools in the engineer's toolbox.{1}
manual.basic_tools.line3: It can be used to configure and form machines, as well as crush ores.{0}
manual.basic_tools.line4: {0}§lEngineer's Wire Cutters§r are used to remove all the wires connected to a block by simply rightclicking it.{1}
manual.basic_tools.line5: Wirecutters can also remove wires strung between poles when worked with.{0}
manual.basic_tools.line6: {0}Engineer's Screwdrivers are another common item in toolboxes.{1}
manual.basic_tools.line7: They are used for precise configuration on certain pieces of machinery.{0}
manual.basic_tools.line9: Aiming it at any energy storage or rightclicking it will read its current storage.{0}
manual.basic_tools.line10: Sneak+rightclick two connectors to calculate the average loss between them.{0}
manual.basic_tools.line11: Multimeters can also be used to read redstone levels of blocks such as redstone connectors and redstone dust.
